resolution: Explained the queried geometry without changing the model: the ten radiator_fin cuboids were intended as radiator cooling ribs, but their z extent (-0.7285..0.7285 m) sits inside each radiator bank (-0.816..0.816 m) and behind the fan faces, so they have no visible or gameplay effect in the current prop. They should be removed or rebuilt as exposed corrugations if revised.
